entries.exactPassage: Look at your Financial Independence Plan. Does it serve this sweet spot? If your plan makes you rich but keeps you from your sweet spot, is it the right plan? What needs to change?
entries.concern: The exact Financial Independence Plan is formally launched in Lesson 69, while this task asks learners to look at it already. Earlier system/vision work can provide the intended starting point, without pretending a completed final project exists.
entries.proposedWording: Use your current financial system and vision as the starting point. As you develop the Financial Independence Plan, check whether it serves your sweet spot and what needs to change.
entries.implementationImpact: Optional separate source-reference review; preserve task meaning, existing responses and identities. The local guide uses actual earlier work now.

entries.exactPassage: Question 3: Which suggestion did you decline, and can you explain your decision respectfully?
entries.concern: The question presupposes that a suggestion was declined, although a learner may reasonably accept all useful feedback. Requiring a rejected suggestion can elicit invented evidence.
entries.proposedWording: If you declined a suggestion, explain your decision respectfully. If you accepted all useful suggestions, state that honestly and explain one decision.
entries.implementationImpact: Separate question-meaning review before any canonical edit. Preserve the existing response identity and count; do not silently change or add a question now.
